summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for Maven spring-boot-maven-plugin fork attribute removal during Spring Boot 3.0 migration. It does not match any existing skill by semantic capability (existing skills cover ProcessPoolExecutor worker lifecycle and Flink watermark configuration, which are unrelated domains). Peer candidates are build-configuration siblings (Gradle Kotlin DSL, Spring Security dispatcher types, properties migrator) but represent different build systems and configuration targets, not overlapping Maven plugin migration. Candidate has valid support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and no conflicts.
